flags.description: Danone was among several companies that suspended palm oil sourcing from First Resources after a 2021 investigation found the supplier controlled a network of shadow companies responsible for more deforestation in Southeast Asia than any other palm oil company.

A local trout farmer sued Danone's Volvic operation after the stream feeding his fish farm dried up, separately also suing the French state; annual water pumping for the Volvic brand grew from about 200,000 litres in 1950 to 1.7 billion litres in 2020, raising local concern about groundwater depletion.

In April 2018, Danone North America became a Certified B Corporation — at the time the world's largest B Corp by revenue — committing to rigorous independently verified standards for social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency.
